description: This Java class defines a custom exception called ClientActiveForUpdateException, which extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException. It is used within the Fineract project to indicate that a client is active and cannot be updated for a specific parameter.

classes.name: ClientActiveForUpdateException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a client is active and cannot be updated with certain parameters.

methods.name: ClientActiveForUpdateException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message based on the client ID and parameter name.
